# skycloak_identity_provider (Resource)

An identity provider (SSO connection) in a Skycloak realm.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skycloak_identity_provider" "google" {
  cluster_id   = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm_name   = skycloak_realm.app.name
  provider_id  = "google"
  type         = "oidc"
  display_name = "Sign in with Google"
  enabled      = true

  client_id     = "your-google-client-id"
  client_secret = var.google_client_secret

  config = {
    button_text = "Sign in with Google"

    oidc = {
      issuer            = "https://accounts.google.com"
      authorization_url = "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth"
      token_url         = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"
    }

    attribute_mappings = {
      email = "email"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.
- `config` (Attributes) Provider configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `provider_id` (String) Unique provider alias within the realm. Immutable.
- `realm_name` (String) Realm name. Immutable.
- `type` (String) Provider kind: `oidc`, `saml`, or `ldap`. Immutable.

### Optional

- `client_id` (String) Upstream client/application ID.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Upstream client secret. Write-only; never read back.
- `display_name` (String) Display name shown on the login page.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the provider is enabled. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `externally_managed` (Boolean) True if the provider is managed outside Skycloak; such providers reject updates and deletes.
- `id` (String) Composite ID `cluster_id/realm_name/provider_id`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Optional:

- `attribute_mappings` (Map of String) Keycloak attribute → IdP claim mappings.
- `button_text` (String) Login button label.
- `icon_url` (String) Login button icon URL.
- `ldap` (Attributes) LDAP settings (when `type` is `ldap`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--ldap))
- `oidc` (Attributes) OIDC endpoints (when `type` is `oidc`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--oidc))
- `saml` (Attributes) SAML settings (when `type` is `saml`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--saml))
- `sync_mode` (String) User profile sync mode (`IMPORT`, `LEGACY`, `FORCE`).
- `trust_email` (Boolean) Trust email addresses from this provider.

<a id="nestedatt--config--ldap"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.ldap`

Optional:

- `bind_dn` (String) Bind DN.
- `server_url` (String) LDAP server URL.
